item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00437","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C19","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 is the immediately preceding annual Red Cross campaign memorandum and supplies both the child’s structure and distinctive wording. Both address heads of executive departments and agencies, begin by describing the Red Cross’s humanitarian purposes and the support of Federal employees and military personnel, explain that the preceding year was unusually costly, identify March as the campaign period, and close by anticipating strong support throughout the Federal establishment, including personnel overseas. The child substantially condenses and updates C06’s factual predicate while retaining its drafting framework. C19 and C23 are relevant earlier Red Cross campaign memoranda, but their language and organization are less closely reproduced.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The American Red Cross is close to the hearts of all who are concerned with the needs of their neighbors. Because of its humanitarian purposes and effective work, Federal employees and military personnel have long given their support to its programs.","parent_excerpt":"Because of its humanitarian purposes, the American Red Cross is close to the hearts of all who are concerned with the welfare of others. Federal employees and military personnel have demonstrated this fact through their splendid record of contributions to the Red Cross.","explanation":"This is a distinctive near-verbatim opening, with only modest substitutions and compression."},{"child_excerpt":"The past year has been a costly one for the Red Cross. Disaster reserves have been exhausted, and funds available for national emergency are dangerously low.","parent_excerpt":"The past year has been a busy and costly one. Disaster expenditures alone were the highest in seventy-five years","explanation":"Both use the prior year’s exceptional disaster costs as the central factual justification for unusually strong support."},{"child_excerpt":"In March, therefore, when the Red Cross makes its annual appeal for funds, it must receive an unusually generous response.","parent_excerpt":"The 1957 Red Cross Campaign will be conducted during the month of March","explanation":"The child preserves the same annual-campaign timing and fundraising appeal while shortening the administrative detail."},{"child_excerpt":"I am sure that officials and employees throughout the Federal establishment, together with military and civilian personnel overseas, will help make this a memorable campaign for the Red Cross.","parent_excerpt":"It is my desire that officials and employees throughout the Federal establishment cooperate with their respective Red Cross chapters and units and extend their full support to this campaign. I am confident of a response that will do credit to the Federal service and be an important factor in the success of the Red Cross campaign.","explanation":"The closing appeal reuses the same institutional audience, confidence formula, and campaign-success function; the overseas reference also echoes C06’s express coverage of military and civilian personnel overseas."}]}
